answer_1.quote: We prompt several larger decoder-only LLMs to output a list of turn intervals exhibiting friction ... For each predicted turn interval, the model must provide a brief explanation for the cause of friction.
answer_1.outputs: natural language explanations of why a turn interval exhibits conversational friction

answer_4.quote: We ask two non-author Linux experts to annotate the similarity between gold friction explanations and model-generated explanations for 64 instances of friction on a three-point scale, marking them as either (1) dissimilar, (2) somewhat similar, or (3) equivalent.
answer_4.guideline: Annotators rate the similarity between model-generated explanations and gold explanations using a three-point scale (dissimilar, somewhat similar, equivalent).
